name: Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
description: A remarkable ancient rainforest known for mountain gorilla conservation and guided forest experiences.
imageAlt: Dense tropical forest canopy in Uganda
tips: Gorilla tracking requires an advance permit and must be booked through the Uganda Wildlife Authority or an authorised operator. Confirm the sector, current permit rules and fitness guidance before travelling.

name: Queen Elizabeth National Park
description: A varied landscape of savannah, crater lakes and wetlands, with wildlife and boat trips along the Kazinga Channel.
tips: Wildlife sightings vary by season and conditions. Check current park access, activity schedules and safety guidance with the Uganda Wildlife Authority before setting out.

name: Murchison Falls National Park
description: Open savannah, riverine forest and the Nile converge around a dramatic waterfall in Uganda's largest national park.
imageAlt: Waterfall flowing through a green landscape
tips: Check the latest park notices and road or ferry arrangements with the Uganda Wildlife Authority. Use established guides and follow wildlife-distance instructions.

name: Kibale Forest National Park
description: A tropical forest landscape known for chimpanzees and guided walks among rich bird and primate life.
imageAlt: Sunlight filtering through a lush forest
tips: Chimpanzee tracking is permit-based and follows park rules. Confirm current permit availability, age requirements and meeting points with the Uganda Wildlife Authority.

name: Lake Bunyonyi
description: A highland lake ringed by terraced hills, with quiet bays, island views and community-led experiences.
imageAlt: Still lake surrounded by green hills
tips: Ask local hosts about safe swimming and canoe arrangements; conditions and facilities vary by shoreline. Bring layers for cool highland evenings.

name: Jinja & the Source of the Nile
description: A lively riverside town where visitors can learn about the Nile and find a range of guided river activities.
imageAlt: Sunlight over a broad river landscape
tips: For river activities, compare established operators, verify current safety equipment and experience requirements, and follow their local advice.

name: Rwenzori Mountains
description: A dramatic mountain range of high-altitude forests, valleys and distinctive alpine landscapes.
imageAlt: High mountain peaks rising above forested slopes
tips: Multi-day hikes need advance planning, a qualified local guide and suitable equipment. Check park access, route conditions, altitude guidance and weather before booking.

name: Kidepo Valley National Park
description: A remote wilderness of broad valleys, rugged hills and dry-country wildlife in Uganda's north-east.
imageAlt: Wide open savannah and rugged hills
tips: The park is remote and journeys can take time. Confirm current road conditions, transport, accommodation and park information before travel.

name: Mgahinga Gorilla National Park
description: A highland park in the Virunga landscape, with volcanic scenery, forest habitats and guided wildlife experiences.
imageAlt: Volcanic mountain slopes above a green landscape
tips: Some activities require permits and advance planning. Confirm current access, permits, conditions and equipment guidance with the Uganda Wildlife Authority.

name: Sipi Falls
description: A set of waterfalls on the slopes of Mount Elgon, approached through highland farms and village trails.
imageAlt: Waterfall dropping into a green valley
tips: Trails can be steep, slippery and weather-dependent. Use a local guide, wear suitable footwear and check conditions before walking.

name: Entebbe & Lake Victoria
description: A leafy lakeside town with gardens, wildlife conservation experiences and an easy introduction to Lake Victoria.
imageAlt: Calm lake water in the early morning
tips: Check opening arrangements directly with attractions before visiting. Use designated swimming areas and follow local guidance around the lake.

name: Kampala
description: Uganda's capital is a lively city of neighbourhoods, markets, food and cultural landmarks.
imageAlt: City streets and rooftops in warm evening light
tips: Traffic can be busy and journey times vary. Ask your accommodation or a trusted local guide for current transport and neighbourhood advice.
